fields.columns: | columns event.time, event.type, site.name, agent.uuid, src.process.storyline.id, src.process.user, src.process.uid, src.process.cmdline, src.ip.address, src.port.number, dst.ip.address, dst.port.number, src.process.parent.cmdline, tgt.process.cmdline
fields.description: Detects usage of the Chisel tunneling tool via the commandline arguments
fields.name: PUA - Chisel Tunneling Tool Execution
fields.query: event.type="Process Creation" and (endpoint.os="windows" and (tgt.process.image.path contains "\\chisel.exe" or ((tgt.process.cmdline contains "exe client " or tgt.process.cmdline contains "exe server ") and (tgt.process.cmdline contains "-socks5" or tgt.process.cmdline contains "-reverse" or tgt.process.cmdline contains " r:" or tgt.process.cmdline contains ":127.0.0.1:" or tgt.process.cmdline contains "-tls-skip-verify " or tgt.process.cmdline contains ":socks"))))
